repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是面向 AI 智能体的逆向工程工具，集成 Hopper、Ghidra 等引擎，支持无源码剖析原生二进制、Electron 应用及 .NET 运行时行为，实现底层逻辑的自动化分析与复刻。
repos.summary_en: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) is an AI-agent-centric reverse engineering platform designed to bridge AI agents with powerful analysis tools like Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It enables automated, deep inspection of native binaries, Electron applications, .NET assemblies, and web technologies entirely without source code access. By running locally and generating evidence-backed reports, it helps developers understand complex runtime behaviors and binary logic, facilitating the rapid replication of advanced application features in their own development projects.

repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Reach 是面向 AI Agent 的开源 CLI 工具，一键赋予全网阅读与搜索能力。它零 API 费用，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台，有效解决网页访问限制、平台封锁与付费 API 痛点。基于 Python，跨平台部署，显著降低 AI 与互联网交互门槛。
repos.summary_en: Agent Reach is an open-source CLI tool for AI agents, enabling one-click internet reading and searching. With zero API fees, it supports Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu, addressing web access limits, platform blocks, and paid API issues. Python-based and cross-platform, it significantly lowers the barrier for AI-web interaction.

repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 359 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors
repos.summary_zh: OmniRoute是一个免费MIT许可的AI网关，通过统一端点聚合359个提供商、1200+模型，支持Claude Code、Cursor等主流编码工具。其智能配额感知自动回退与RTK+Caveman压缩技术可节省高达95%的令牌成本，适用于需要低成本、多模型访问的开发者与团队。
repos.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free MIT-licensed AI gateway that aggregates 359 providers and over 1,200 models behind a unified endpoint, compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and other coding tools. It features quota-aware auto-fallback and RTK+Caveman compression to save up to 95% tokens, making it ideal for developers and teams seeking low-cost, multi-model AI access.

repos.description: 🔥 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform.
repos.summary_zh: 1Panel是一款现代化开源Linux服务器面板及轻量级AI管理平台。通过直观Web界面提供一站式运维，深度融合AI网关与智能体管理，简化主机与容器管理，助力网站和AI应用快速部署，显著降低运维门槛。
repos.summary_en: 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform loved by a global community of over 2.5 million users. Through an intuitive web interface, it provides comprehensive, one-stop server operations, seamlessly integrating AI gateway, agent, and model management. It streamlines host monitoring, container orchestration, database management, curated app store deployments, and rapid website setup, significantly lowering the technical barrier for efficient server and AI application administration.

repos.description: AI-native knowledge base & Evernote/Obsidian alternative with instant sync & native MCP. Free on Cloudflare or self-hosted via Docker.
repos.summary_zh: EdgeEver 是一个 AI 原生的开源知识库应用，旨在替代 Evernote 和 Obsidian。它提供经典的 Evernote 式三栏布局，支持即时多设备同步，并原生集成 AI Agent 以提升生产力。用户可免费在 Cloudflare 上运行，或通过 Docker 自托管，确保数据完全拥有。适用于个人和团队的知识管理场景。
repos.summary_en: EdgeEver is an AI-native, open-source knowledge base application designed as an alternative to Evernote and Obsidian. It offers a classic Evernote-style three-pane layout with instant multi-device sync and native AI Agent integration for enhanced productivity. Users can run it for free on Cloudflare or self-host via Docker, ensuring complete data ownership. Suitable for personal and team knowledge management.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 构建的轻量级博客系统，集成 MCP 协议支持 AI 智能体管理，具备高性能缓存、安全加固和 SEO 优化，适用于个人与企业快速搭建功能丰富的网站，助力高效内容创作与管理。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight blog system built on Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2, featuring MCP protocol support for AI agent management. It offers high-performance caching, security hardening, and SEO optimization, suitable for quickly building feature-rich websites for individuals and enterprises.

repos.description: 一款集成 AI 助手的轻量级 SSH 终端桌面应用。
repos.summary_zh: CoShell是一款本地优先、安全加密的轻量级桌面SSH/SFTP工作台，深度集成AI智能体。它融合了多标签终端、文件管理与在线编辑，为本地可信环境提供安全离线的AI辅助运维与开发体验。
repos.summary_en: CoShell is a local-first, lightweight desktop SSH and SFTP workstation designed for secure, offline server operations. Integrating a powerful AI agent compatible with OpenAI APIs, local SearXNG search, and an online code editor, it combines multi-tab terminals, SFTP file management, and advanced AES-GCM encryption. It offers a privacy-focused, all-in-one environment for developers and system administrators to execute commands, edit files, and automate workflows safely within trusted local environments, without requiring external dependencies like Docker or CDNs, helping to streamline daily server maintenance and development tasks efficiently.
